source_cn:
我是罗塞尔·古斯塔夫，但我要记得我真正的姓名——黄涛。
        这封日记写于我自己的陵墓中，现在的我既没有活着、也没有死去，只是偶尔会获得短暂的清醒。我似乎迷失了很久，只能一遍又一遍回想我挂念的那些东西，让我不要真的被疯狂与污染控制。
        可笑的是，我曾经拼命搏来的那些荣誉，什么蒸汽机、狗屎蒸汽之子，这些原本就不属于我的东西对稳定认知一点用都没有，只会反噬我。
        我这辈子真正挂念的，是我的孩子们……
ref_en:
I am Roselle Gustav, but I must remember my real name—Huang Tao. 
 This diary was written in my own mausoleum. The current me is neither alive nor dead; I only occasionally gain brief moments of clarity. I seem to have been lost for a long time, and I can only recall the things I care about over and over again so that I am not truly controlled by madness and corruption. 
 It is ridiculous that those honors I fought for with my life, like the steam engine, that bullshit Son of Steam—these things that didn't belong to me in the first place are of no use in stabilizing my cognition and will only backfire on me. 
 The things I truly care about in this life are my children…

The feathers on its antlers emitted a soft light one after another, floating into the air to continue the song Daly hadn't finished. 它来自"秘偶大师"罗萨戈的遗物。那个死去的人曾用它约束过多少秘密？
莎伦苍白的手指抚过橘黄的纸面。把它递给了克莱恩，在煤气灯坏掉的僻静街道上，让明亮的光芒见证一个新的誓言。
符号次第亮起，暖流一闪而逝。
"我好了。"克莱恩将公证书递还了回去。
莎伦平静颔首，淡漠的身影消失在车厢内。
而那张空白的纸页，会继续等待一个新的约定——那是太阳永不熄灭的见证。
ref_en:
It came from the relics of the "Marionettist" Rosago. How many secrets had that dead man constrained with it? 
 Sharron's pale fingers brushed over the orange paper surface. She handed it to Klein, and in the quiet street where the gas lamp was broken, let the bright light witness a new vow. 
 The symbols lit up one by one, and a warm current flashed and vanished. 
 "I'm done," Klein handed the notarization document back. 
 Sharron nodded calmly, and her indifferent figure disappeared into the carriage. 
 And that blank page would continue to wait for a new agreement—that is the witness of the sun that never goes out.

source_cn:
%s，好久不见：
      我听说了你最近与厄水巨龟艰辛的交战。辛苦了，你一直都很努力。我和苏茜搜集了一些有关厄水巨龟的情报，希望能有所帮助：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302106">厄水巨龟的记载</>
      你所承受的命运写满了未知与危险，连我们也无法勘破你身上的迷雾和谜团。未来或许还有更多的险境、更大的危机在等待着我们。我们都需要变得更强，才能保护好自己和珍视的事物。但当你疲惫的时候，欢迎随时来命运咖啡厅坐坐，我这里有不错的红茶和糕点，或许你会喜欢。闲暇的时候，可以来陪我和苏茜聊聊天，让心态平和下来，一切都会好起来的。
      不用担心，我和其他人都会尽力帮助你，随信附上一些提升实力的建议。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s, long time no see: 
      I heard about your recent arduous battle with the Misfortune Water Giant Turtle. You've worked hard; you have always been very diligent. Susie and I have gathered some intelligence regarding the Misfortune Water Giant Turtle, and I hope it proves helpful: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302106">Records of the Misfortune Water Giant Turtle</>
      The fate you bear is filled with unknowns and dangers; even we cannot pierce through the mist and mysteries surrounding you. Perhaps more perilous situations and greater crises await us in the future. We all need to become stronger to protect ourselves and the things we cherish. But when you are exhausted, you are always welcome to come to the Fate Café for a seat. I have some excellent black tea and pastries here that you might enjoy. In your spare time, feel free to come chat with Susie and me to calm your mind; everything will be alright. 
      Do not worry; I and the others will do our best to help you. Attached to this letter are some suggestions for improving your strength. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

从我们毕业到现在，已经过去了五年。战争的阴霾已从家乡的上空离开，一切都回到了最初的模样，甚至比当初更好。我想，贝克兰德一定恢复的比这里更迅速。\n　　听说现在的你成了大经理，我由衷地为你闪耀的前途而感到高兴，小镇出身的姑娘如今走到这样的高度，命运终于恰当的奖赏了应当奖赏的人。\n　　我本想来贝克兰德当面庆贺，但小米勒最近的身体状况不大好，因此你的旅游邀约我不得不暂时拒绝。但别担心，亲爱的，我想我们未来总会有时间再见一面。
ref_en: It has been five years since we graduated. The shadow of war has lifted from our hometown, and everything has returned to how it was, or even better. I imagine Backlund must have recovered even faster than here.\nI heard you have become a great manager now, and I am sincerely happy for your bright future. A girl from a small town has reached such heights; fate has finally rewarded those who deserve it.\nI intended to come to Backlund to congratulate you in person, but little Miller's health hasn't been great lately, so I have to decline your travel invitation for now. But don't worry, my dear, I believe we will have time to meet again in the future.

source_cn: 子弹追回二十三颗……但死了很多人，这值不值得呢？我不知道。这城市烂透了。但总得有人去挖出这些烂肉——哪怕只剩我一个。\n　　如果下次再有这种事，我可能还得找你。毕竟我也没有其他可以信任的人了。\n　　最近我发现自己好像影子都变淡了，大概是酒喝多了。你也要注意身体。
ref_en: Twenty-three bullets recovered… but so many people died. Is it worth it? I don't know. This city is rotten to the core. But someone has to dig out this rotting flesh—even if I'm the only one left.\nIf something like this happens again, I might have to come to you. After all, I have no one else I can trust.\nRecently, I've noticed my shadow seems to be fading; it's probably because I've been drinking too much. You should take care of your health too.

<Assistant_Title1>【灰雾测试充值返还】</>
<Assistant_Title2>返还概述：</>「灰雾测试」为计费删档测试。测试期间累计充值的金额（含购买金镑、愚者福音、时代恩典、命运馈赠及其他现金付费商品），将在公测后按规则返还，<Assistant_Red>1元=10金镑</>。
<Assistant_Title2>金镑/绑定金镑返还：</>累计充值<Assistant_Red>0~4000元</>部分，返还120%金镑+50%绑定金镑；超过4000元部分，仅返还120%金镑，不额外赠送绑定金镑。举例：充值5000元，金镑返还60000（5000×10×120%），绑定金镑返还20000（4000×10×50%）。
<Assistant_Title2>愚者福音返还：</>购买愚者福音的金额计入累计充值，公测后返还愚者福音道具，<Assistant_Red>最多返还2份</>；超过2份的金额仍计入充值总额但不额外返还道具。返还道具需主动使用，使用后获得30天权益，不会再次获得购买时赠送的金镑。
<Assistant_Title2>时代恩典/命运馈赠返还：</>购买金额同样计入累计充值，公测后返还对应战令道具。若多角色购买多份战令，<Assistant_Red>最多返还1份</>，优先返还更高档位的命运馈赠；其余战令金额仍计入充值总额但不额外返还道具。
<Assistant_Title2>领取方式：</>公测后使用同一账号登录对应渠道，创建角色并完成第一章主线任务后，会收到返利邮件通知，前往<Assistant_Property1>廷根</>与NPC<Assistant_Property2>吉福特</>对话领取。返还的道具保存至背包，需主动使用后激活，使用前不会失效。
<Assistant_Title2>领取期限：</>公测后<Assistant_Red>6个月</>内有效，过期后不再支持领取。同一账号下返利仅可由<Assistant_Red>一名角色领取一次</>，无法跨账号转移。官服充值仅可在官服领取，渠道服充值仅可在渠道服领取。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Gray Fog Test Recharge Refund】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Refund Overview: </>"Gray Fog Test" is a paid data-wiping test. The total amount recharged during the test (including purchases of Gold Pounds, Fool's Gospel, Era's Grace, Fate's Gift, and other cash-paid items) will be refunded after the official launch according to the rules, <Assistant_Red>1 Yuan = 10 Gold Pounds</>.
<Assistant_Title2>Gold Pound/Bound Gold Pound Refund: </>For the cumulative recharge portion of <Assistant_Red>0~4000 Yuan</>, 120% Gold Pounds + 50% Bound Gold Pounds will be refunded; for the portion exceeding 4000 Yuan, only 120% Gold Pounds will be refunded, with no additional Bound Gold Pounds. Example: For a 5000 Yuan recharge, 60000 Gold Pounds (5000×10×120%) and 20000 Bound Gold Pounds (4000×10×50%) will be refunded.
<Assistant_Title2>Fool's Gospel Refund: </>The amount spent on purchasing Fool's Gospel counts towards the cumulative recharge. After the official launch, Fool's Gospel items will be refunded, <Assistant_Red>up to a maximum of 2 copies</>; amounts exceeding 2 copies still count towards the total recharge but no additional items will be refunded. Refunded items must be actively used to obtain 30 days of benefits; you will not receive the Gold Pounds gifted at the time of purchase again.
<Assistant_Title2>Era's Grace/Fate's Gift Refund: </>Purchase amounts also count towards the cumulative recharge. After the official launch, corresponding Battle Pass items will be refunded. If multiple characters purchase multiple Battle Passes, <Assistant_Red>a maximum of 1 copy will be refunded</>, prioritizing the higher-tier Fate's Gift; the remaining Battle Pass amounts still count towards the total recharge but no additional items will be refunded.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Claim: </>After the official launch, log in with the same account on the corresponding platform, create a character, and complete the Chapter 1 main quest. You will receive a rebate notification email. Go to <Assistant_Property1>Tingen</> and talk to the NPC <Assistant_Property2>Gifford</> to claim it. Refunded items are saved to the Inventory and must be actively used to activate; they will not expire before use.
<Assistant_Title2>Claim Deadline: </>Valid within <Assistant_Red>6 months</> after the official launch; claims will not be supported after expiration. Rebates under the same account can only be claimed by <Assistant_Red>one character once</> and cannot be transferred across accounts. Official server recharges can only be claimed on the official server, and platform server recharges can only be claimed on the platform server.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【非凡扮演】</>

<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找非凡扮演</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【非凡扮演】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。

<Assistant_Title3>2. 扮演序列者</>
与光球互动，完成检定后即可进入对应途径的非凡扮演，体验专属非凡能力。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 获取奖励</>

ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Extraordinary Roleplay】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>Spheres of light containing the abilities of other pathways. <Assistant_Red>Touch </>them to utilize the extraordinary abilities of different pathways and find hidden treasure chests.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding Extraordinary Roleplay</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Extraordinary Roleplay] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Extraordinary Roleplay] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Roleplaying a Sequence Beyonder</>
Interact with the sphere of light and complete the check to enter the Extraordinary Roleplay of the corresponding pathway and experience exclusive extraordinary abilities.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Obtaining Rewards</>
After finishing the roleplay, you will receive a hidden treasure chest reward and increase the completion progress of the current map.

source_cn:
这地方太邪门了。已经失踪三个人了，寻宝队的其他人居然还要继续？他们有病吧？
　　想不通，真的想不通。为什么这么多人发现怪事还不跑？考古的、勘探的、寻宝的……他们不要命了吗？
　　算了，罗塞尔大帝曾说过，人各有命——我先逃了。顺着这条河划出去，然后找个教堂住下，天天祷告直到这邪门的事过去。
　　再见了！这见鬼的霍纳奇斯山！
ref_en:
This place is too evil. Three people have already gone missing, and the rest of the treasure hunting team actually wants to continue? Are they sick? 
 I can't understand it, I really can't. Why don't so many people run away after discovering strange things? Archaeologists, surveyors, treasure hunters... don't they value their lives? 
 Forget it, Emperor Roselle once said, everyone has their own fate—I'm escaping first. I'll row out along this river, then find a church to stay in, praying every day until this evil matter passes. 
 Goodbye! This godforsaken Hornacis Mountain!

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>结交人脉</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>
借助封印物<Assistant_Property1>历史回廊</>，可在历史孔隙中寻找散落在历史中的人物（{SendAnswer:人脉|550}），与他们结识，向过去借取力量。
<Assistant_Title2>结交方式：</>
点击<Assistant_System>菜单-人脉-结交人脉</>进入结交界面，而后点击结交1次/5次，即可进行结交。
<Assistant_Title2>结交消耗：</>
每一次结交需要消耗一盏{SendAnswer:历史明灯|556}。
<Assistant_Title2>结交规则：</>
1、在结交活动中，每5次结交，必定获得一位史诗或以上的人脉。
2、如果连续24次结交未获得传说人脉，则后续概率逐渐提升。每40次结交必定获得传说人脉。获得传说人脉后计数重置，概率恢复为基础概率。
3、常驻结交活动与限时结交活动的保底次数会一直累积在对应活动中，互相独立计算，互不影响。
4、对于常驻结交活动，可许愿指定人脉，提升结交时获得对应人脉的概率。
5、重复获得相同人脉时，将额外获得{SendAnswer:投影片段|557}。如果该人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，获得的投影片段数量将提高。投影片段可用于在{SendAnswer:人脉商店|558}兑换历史明灯、特定人脉。
<Assistant_Title2>结交记录：</>
可在<Assistant_System>人脉-结交人脉-对应结交活动-历史记录</>查看对应类型结交活动的结交记录。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[人脉]|550}，{SendAnswer:[关系]|551}，{SendAnswer:[人脉许愿]|555}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>Make Connections</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description: </>
With the help of the Sealed Artifact <Assistant_Property1>Historical Void</>, you can search for figures scattered in history ({SendAnswer:Connections|550}) within the gaps of history, get to know them, and borrow power from the past.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Connect: </>
Click <Assistant_System>Menu-Connections-Make Connections</> to enter the connection interface, then click Connect 1 time/5 times to perform a connection.
<Assistant_Title2>Connection Cost: </>
Each connection requires one {SendAnswer:Historical Beacon|556}.
<Assistant_Title2>Connection Rules: </>
1. In connection events, every 5 connections guarantee an Epic or higher Connection.
2. If no Legendary Connection is obtained after 24 consecutive connections, the subsequent probability will gradually increase. Every 40 connections guarantee a Legendary Connection. After obtaining a Legendary Connection, the count resets, and the probability returns to the base probability.
3. The pity counts for permanent connection events and limited-time connection events will always accumulate within their respective events, calculated independently and not affecting each other.
4. For permanent connection events, you can wish for a specific Connection to increase the probability of obtaining it during connections.
5. When obtaining a duplicate Connection, you will additionally obtain {SendAnswer:Projection Fragments|557}. If the Connection has already reached the ultimate level or the materials are sufficient to upgrade it to the ultimate level, the number of Projection Fragments obtained will increase. Projection Fragments can be used in the {SendAnswer:Connection Shop|558} to exchange for Historical Beacons or specific Connections.
<Assistant_Title2>Connection Records: </>
You can view the connection records for the corresponding type of connection event in <Assistant_System>Connections-Make Connections-Corresponding Connection Event-History Records</>.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Search: </>{SendAnswer:[Connections]|550}, {SendAnswer:[Relationships]|551}, {SendAnswer:[Connection Wish]|555}

海伦娜·威瑟尔有许多身份和过往。
在她短暂的一生中，曾是热爱泥土的“怪”小姐、可怜的孤女、无情的死神、成功复仇的传奇……
在她短暂成为善良和慷慨的母亲后，命运依旧热衷于戏耍她，短暂赐予她幸福，又永恒地剥夺。
最终，看到儿子身染重病、即将丧命时，她终于下定决心。
“我不能再失去……任何人了。”
她要向命运复仇。
哪怕为此牺牲一切，她的爱，她的血，她曾引以为傲的理智。
只要种子重新长成鲜活的苹果。
命运，就无法完全吞没她。
ref_en:
Helena Wetherell had many identities and pasts. 
 In her short life, she had been a "strange" lady who loved the soil, a poor orphan, a ruthless Death, a legendary figure who successfully took revenge... 
 After she briefly became a kind and generous mother, fate still loved to tease her, briefly bestowing happiness upon her, only to take it away eternally. 
 Finally, seeing her son suffering from a serious illness and about to die, she finally made up her mind. 
 "I cannot lose... anyone else." 
 She wanted to take revenge on fate. 
 Even if she had to sacrifice everything, her love, her blood, the reason she was once proud of. 
 As long as the seed grew into a fresh apple again. 
 Fate would not be able to swallow her completely.

source_cn:
艾莉卡发现了。她质问我和贝丝的关系……争吵……我发誓我不是故意的……但磨坊烧起来了……她还在里面，她……
　　……即使我出身贵族，发生这么大的事治安官也会找上门来。我必须去找贝丝。她在骨桥等我。她说会带我躲进山里……
　　等等……贝丝身边的那个人是谁……那张脸……那不是艾莉卡吗？！她不是已经……
　　她们在笑……向我走来……她们的脸在变化……变得和我……一样……
ref_en:
Erika found out. She questioned my relationship with Beth... an argument... I swear I didn't mean to... but the mill caught fire... She was still inside, she...
    ...Even with my noble background, the magistrate will come knocking after such a major incident. I must find Beth. She's waiting for me at the Bone Bridge. She said she would take me into the mountains to hide...
    Wait... who is that person next to Beth... that face... isn't that Erika?! Didn't she already...
    They are laughing... walking toward me... their faces are changing... becoming the same... as mine...

亲爱的朋友们：
　　你们读到这行字时，我大概正趴在甲板上抢救被狂暴海的巨浪打翻的芒果青柠酱。
　　很高兴地告诉大家，我战时的灵感“黑麦朗姆弹壳泡芙”已经找到了绝佳的制作材料——因蒂斯南部的褐色李子，它们的甜度正好能中和朗姆的苦涩。
　　我不久后就会回到鲁恩，真想快点将这一路上的冒险故事分享给你们！
　　备注：如果邮差送来草垛扎着的木箱，请不要打开——那八成是我从某个岛上找到的变异蘑菇，能挤出牛奶，真是太神奇了。
ref_en:
Dear friends:
　　By the time you read this, I am likely sprawled on the deck, desperately trying to save the mango-lime sauce that was overturned by the giant waves of the Berserk Sea.
　　I am happy to tell you all that I have finally found the perfect ingredient for my wartime inspiration, the 'Rye Rum Shell Puff'—brown plums from southern Intis. Their sweetness is just enough to neutralize the bitterness of the rum.
　　I will be returning to Loen soon, and I can't wait to share the adventure stories from this journey with you!
　　Note: If the postman delivers a wooden crate tied with straw, please do not open it—it is most likely a mutated mushroom I found on some island. It can be squeezed to produce milk; it's truly magical.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【终末猎杀】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>终末猎杀</>是发生在<Assistant_Property1>猎龙之城</>的野外<Assistant_Red>500人混战</>玩法。你可以击败超凡生物或敌对玩家，获得<Assistant_Property1>猩红遗物材料</>与段位胜点。
<Assistant_Title2>核心目标：</>将<Assistant_Property1>猩红遗物材料</>提交给<Assistant_System>猎杀管家</>，推进猎杀进度并解锁阶段奖励。猩红遗物仅在猎龙之城内有效，离开后将自动失效并清除。
<Assistant_Title2>猎杀时刻：</>玩法全天开放；每日<Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</>为猎杀时刻，周六、周日额外开放<Assistant_Red>14:00—15:00</>。猎杀时刻期间，击杀或被击杀时涉及的段位胜点数量翻倍。
<Assistant_Title2>王城事件：</>每周五、周日晚的猎杀时刻开启10分钟后，即<Assistant_Red>19:10</>，王城中心刷新巨龙·投影；除周五、周日晚场外，其他猎杀时刻开始10分钟后刷新王城守卫者。
<Assistant_Title2>团队结算：</>击杀者及最多29名符合助攻条件的同团队成员参与奖励结算。猩红遗物按参与人数平均分配，余数优先分配给击杀者1个，其余在其他参与者中随机分配。
<Assistant_Title2>掠夺规则：</>玩家头顶显示的碎片数量越多，抢夺猩红遗物的比例越高；头顶碎片数每提高500个，抢夺比例相应提升。
<Assistant_Title2>段位规则：</>段位低于<Assistant_Red>伯爵1阶</>时，被击杀不会损失段位胜点。每日01:00—08:00及短时间内重复击杀同一目标时，击杀玩家获得的段位胜点将按规则衰减。
<Assistant_Title2>参与方式：</>{JumpToUI:[前往终末猎杀]|1250342}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Final Hunt】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions:</><Assistant_System>Final Hunt</> is a 500-player open-field <Assistant_Red>battle royale</> mode that takes place in the <Assistant_Property1>City of Dragon Hunting</>. You can defeat Beyonder creatures or hostile players to obtain <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> and Rank Points.
<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective:</> Submit <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> to the <Assistant_System>Hunting Butler</> to advance the hunting progress and unlock stage rewards. Scarlet Relics are only effective within the City of Dragon Hunting; they will automatically expire and be cleared upon leaving.
<Assistant_Title2>Hunting Time:</> The mode is available all day; <Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</> daily is Hunting Time, with an additional session on Saturdays and Sundays from <Assistant_Red>14:00—15:00</>. During Hunting Time, the number of Rank Points involved in kills or deaths is doubled.
<Assistant_Title2>Royal City Event:</> 10 minutes after the start of the Hunting Time on Friday and Sunday nights, i.e., at <Assistant_Red>19:10</>, a Dragon - Projection will spawn in the center of the Royal City; outside of the Friday and Sunday night sessions, a Royal City Guardian will spawn 10 minutes after the start of other Hunting Times.
<Assistant_Title2>Team Settlement:</> The killer and up to 29 eligible team members who contributed assists participate in the reward settlement. Scarlet Relics are distributed equally among participants, with any remainder given first to the killer, and the rest distributed randomly among other participants.
<Assistant_Title2>Plunder Rules:</> The more fragments displayed above a player's head, the higher the percentage of Scarlet Relics that can be plundered; for every 500 additional fragments, the plunder percentage increases accordingly.
<Assistant_Title2>Rank Rules:</> When your rank is below <Assistant_Red>Earl Tier 1</>, you will not lose Rank Points upon being killed. Rank Points gained from killing players will decay according to the rules between 01:00—08:00 daily and when killing the same target repeatedly within a short period.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate:</>{JumpToUI:[Go to Final Hunt]|1250342}

ref_en: Friend/Enemy Relationship </> Members of the same team, group, or Club are considered allies; <Highlight> all other players are hostile </> and can be attacked freely. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Team Settlement </> When defeating a hostile player, the killer and up to <Highlight> 29 </> team members who meet the assist criteria participate in this Crimson Relic and Rank Point settlement. The distributable Crimson Relics are divided equally among the participants and rounded down. If there is a remainder, the killer gets priority for 1 extra, and the rest are distributed randomly among other participants, with each person receiving at most 1 extra. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Plunder Rules </> After defeating a hostile player, you can plunder <Highlight> Rank Points </> and the <Highlight> Crimson Relics </> they hold from the target. The more fragments displayed above a player's head, the higher the percentage of Crimson Relics that can be plundered; for every <Highlight> 500 </> fragments above the head, the plunder percentage increases accordingly. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Rank Protection </> Players with a rank lower than <Highlight> Earl Tier 1 </> will not lose Rank Points when killed. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Rank Point Decay </> Daily <Highlight> 01:00—08:00 </>, Rank Points obtained from killing players are adjusted to <Highlight> 10% </> of the normal value; Rank Points provided by hunting progress are not affected. When the same player kills the same target repeatedly within 10 minutes, the 1st—3rd times grant 100% Rank Points, the 4th time grants 50%, the 5th time grants 20%, and the 6th time and onwards grant none. When both decay rules are in effect simultaneously, the final result is calculated by multiplying the proportions.

source_cn:
好久不见。
　　自廷根湖异变后，值夜者封锁了廷根湖边区域处理遗留的污染，目前已经处理完毕，重新解除了封锁。
　　不过最近巡逻的同事告诉我，湖边近日忽然多了几张桌椅和帐篷，应该解除封锁后，有人来到这边进行了活动。
　　保险起见，值夜者需要调查来到这边的人是否安全。如果你有时间的话，我希望你可以来廷根湖这边协助我们调查。
　　新同事，期待着与你再一次见面。
ref_en:
Long time no see. 
 Since the Tingen Lake anomaly, the Nighthawks have sealed off the area by Tingen Lake to handle the residual corruption. It has now been processed, and the blockade has been lifted. 
 However, colleagues on patrol recently told me that a few tables, chairs, and tents have suddenly appeared by the lake. It seems someone has been active here since the blockade was lifted. 
 To be safe, the Nighthawks need to investigate whether the people who came here are safe. If you have time, I hope you can come to Tingen Lake to assist us with the investigation. 
 New colleague, looking forward to seeing you again.

source_cn:
<TarotTextCurrent>{{PlayerName}}</>与<TarotTextCurrent>黑荆棘安保公司</>签订本合同。经双方协商，签订如下条款：

　　即日起，立约人加入黑荆棘安保公司，成为正式员工。薪资及保密补贴另议。立约人须严格遵守保密条款，违反条款将受到黑夜女神教会仲裁庭的直接审判。

　　本合同有效期为十四年，期满后可视情况，决定是否续签。

　　出于安全考虑和保密原则，立约人如离开廷根市，须保证公司已知情或批准。
ref_en:
<TarotTextCurrent>{{PlayerName}}</> enters into this contract with <TarotTextCurrent>Blackthorn Security Company</>. Through mutual negotiation, the following terms are agreed upon: 

 Effective immediately, the signatory joins Blackthorn Security Company as a formal employee. Salary and confidentiality subsidies are to be discussed separately. The signatory must strictly abide by the confidentiality clauses; violation of these clauses will result in a direct trial by the Nighthawks' Tribunal of the Evernight Goddess Church. 

 This contract is valid for fourteen years, after which it may be renewed depending on the circumstances. 

 For safety and confidentiality reasons, if the signatory leaves Tingen, they must ensure the company is informed or has granted approval.

世界就这样告终
世界就这样告终

ref_en:
We whisper together 
 Quiet and meaningless 
 Like wind blowing over dry grass 
 Or rats' feet over broken glass 
 In our dry cellar 

 Shape without form, shade without color 
 Paralyzed force, gesture without motion; 
 Those who have crossed 
 With direct eyes, to death's other Kingdom 
 Remember us—if at all—not as lost 

 Violent souls, but only 
 As the hollow men 
 We grope together 
 And avoid speech 
 Gathered on this beach of this tumid river 
 At five o'clock in the morning 

 Between the idea 
 And the reality 
 Between the motion 
 And the act 
 Falls the Shadow 
 This is the way the world ends 
 This is the way the world ends 
 This is the way the world ends 
 Not with a bang but a whimper

这地方太邪门了。已经失踪三个人了，寻宝队的其他人居然还要继续？他们有病吧？

　　算了，罗塞尔大帝曾说过，人各有命——我先逃了。顺着这条河划出去，然后找个教堂住下，天天祷告直到这邪门的事过去。
　　再见了！这见鬼的霍纳奇斯山！
ref_en:
This place is too evil. Three people have already gone missing, and the rest of the treasure hunting team still wants to continue? Are they sick?
	I can't figure it out, I really can't figure it out. Why do so many people see strange things and still not run? Archaeologists, surveyors, treasure hunters... don't they want to live?
	Forget it, Emperor Roselle once said, everyone has their own fate—I'm escaping first. I'll row out along this river, then find a church to stay in, and pray every day until this evil thing passes.
	Goodbye! This godforsaken Hornacis Mountain!

当开启"记忆的传承"仪式时通往记忆世界的大门将为你开启——那里沉淀着你的过去，你曾经历过的惊心动魄的战斗时刻。

这些记忆中的强敌将以当年的姿态重现，等待着新的挑战者。当你踏入记忆世界，便可以与这些历史中的对手交锋，再度证明自己。

ref_en:
When the "Inheritance of Memory" ritual is activated, the door to the memory world will open for you—a place where your past is deposited, containing the thrilling combat moments you have experienced. 

 These formidable enemies from your memories will reappear in their former states, waiting for new challengers. Once you step into the memory world, you can clash with these historical opponents and prove yourself once again. 

 Conquering them is a testament to your own strength; if you fight side-by-side with family members, it will also be a tribute to the family's memories. When family members gather to enter the memory world together, the family bond will manifest as tangible power, granting the two buff effects [Burning Vow of Fire] and [Bloodline Covenant], engraving glory into the family crest and becoming a permanent inheritance for the family.

<Assistant_Title1>【事件】</>
<Assistant_Title2>事件目标：</>城市暗面中会不断发生各类突发事件。参与并完成事件，即可获得悬赏奖励，并推进玩法进度。
<Assistant_Title2>小贴士：</>优先完成{SendAnswer:剧情事件|879}，可逐步解锁更多{SendAnswer:挑战事件|880}与{SendAnswer:竞技事件|881}，体验完整的城市暗面内容。
<Assistant_Title2>1.事件类型（包含三种）：</>
<Assistant_Title3>①剧情事件：</>推进剧情，解锁更多玩法内容。
<Assistant_Title3>②挑战事件：</>完成首领挑战、竞速等玩法，获得丰富奖励，注意：激战·邦尼会根据玩家战力转化属性，影响挑战。
<Assistant_Title3>③竞技事件：</>参与资源争夺、追逐战，与其他玩家同场竞技。
<Assistant_Title2>2.事件刷新规则：</>仅会显示当前已解锁且满足开启条件的事件。随着剧情推进，将逐步解锁更多事件。
<Assistant_Title3>剧情事件：</>完成前置条件后解锁，不会随机刷新。
<Assistant_Title3>挑战事件：</>满足开启条件后持续刷新，完成后约10秒重新出现。
<Assistant_Title3>竞技事件：</>每日指定时间开放匹配，匹配成功后开启。
<Assistant_Title2>3.奖励规则：</>
<Assistant_Title3>①剧情事件：</>完成即可领取奖励。
<Assistant_Title3>②挑战事件：</>竞速挑战根据排名发放奖励；激战·邦尼根据表现有分档奖励；困难首领事件不设分档奖励。
<Assistant_Title3>③竞技事件：</>根据最终排名发放奖励。
<Assistant_Title2>4.奖励上限：</>事件奖励领取次数不限，每周可获得的悬赏值存在上限。达到上限后仍可继续参与事件，但不会继续获得悬赏值。
<Assistant_Title2>5.失败条件：</>
未在规定时间内完成事件目标。
事件过程中离开事件区域过远，视为主动放弃。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Event】</>
<Assistant_Title2> Event Objective: </> Various sudden events will constantly occur in the dark side of the city. Participate in and complete events to receive bounty rewards and advance gameplay progress. 
<Assistant_Title2> Tips: </> Prioritize completing {SendAnswer: Plot Events | 879 } to gradually unlock more {SendAnswer: Challenge Events | 880 } and {SendAnswer: Competition Events | 881 }, and experience the full content of the city's dark side. 
<Assistant_Title2> 1. Event Types (includes three): </>
<Assistant_Title3> ① Plot Events: </> Advance the plot and unlock more gameplay content. 
<Assistant_Title3> ② Challenge Events: </> Complete boss challenges, speed runs, and other modes to receive rich rewards. Note: Fierce Battle · Bonnie will convert attributes based on the player's combat power, affecting the challenge. 
<Assistant_Title3> ③ Competition Events: </> Participate in resource contention and chase battles to compete with other players in the same arena. 
<Assistant_Title2> 2. Event Refresh Rules: </> Only events that are currently unlocked and meet the activation conditions will be displayed. As the plot progresses, more events will be unlocked. 
<Assistant_Title3> Plot Events: </> Unlocked after completing prerequisites; they do not refresh randomly. 
<Assistant_Title3> Challenge Events: </> Continuously refresh after meeting activation conditions; they reappear approximately 10 seconds after completion. 
<Assistant_Title3> Competition Events: </> Matching opens at designated times every day; starts after successful matching. 
<Assistant_Title2> 3. Reward Rules: </>
<Assistant_Title3> ① Plot Events: </> Receive rewards upon completion. 
<Assistant_Title3> ② Challenge Events: </> Speed run challenges distribute rewards based on ranking; Fierce Battle · Bonnie has tiered rewards based on performance; difficult boss events do not have tiered rewards. 
<Assistant_Title3> ③ Competition Events: </> Rewards are distributed based on final ranking. 
<Assistant_Title2> 4. Reward Limit: </> There is no limit to the number of times event rewards can be claimed, but there is a weekly cap on the bounty value that can be obtained. You can continue to participate in events after reaching the cap, but you will not continue to receive bounty value. 
<Assistant_Title2> 5. Failure Conditions: </>
 Failure to complete the event objective within the specified time. 
 Leaving the event area too far during the event is considered a voluntary withdrawal.

您的好意一如既往，您的行为让我困惑。
　　您真的只是可怜我吗？这就是您的心意？

　　……想必这封信也不会收到您的答复，但我会一直在这里，等待着您的出现。
　　我从未见过春天，我的世界里，只有您来了。
ref_en:
Your kindness is as always, your behavior confuses me. 
    Are you really just pitying me? Is this your true intention? 
    Can you at least speak to me face-to-face once? 
    ...I suppose this letter won't receive a reply from you either, but I will always be here, waiting for your appearance. 
    I have never seen spring; in my world, only you have arrived.

一段时间不见，有想我吗？
我是上个冬天来到这里的灰色花猫，最爱睡在集市的丝瓜筐里。
我想对帮过我的人说，谢谢你们。
如果没有那些碎肉和剩鱼，我早就长不大啦。
最近，我住进了村口的稻草房子里，也有了新的名字。
我叫<Letter_Highlight_HW>毛毛草</>，再见面的时候，请叫我的名字吧。
谢谢你们！
ref_en:
Haven't seen you for a while, did you miss me? 
 I came here last winter as a gray tabby cat, and I love sleeping in the loofah basket at the market. 
 I want to say thank you to those who helped me. 
 If it weren't for those scraps of meat and leftover fish, I wouldn't have grown up. 
 Recently, I moved into the straw house at the entrance of the village and have a new name. 
 My name is <Letter_Highlight_HW> Fluffgrass </>, please call my name when we meet again. 
 Thank you all!

source_cn:
阳光斜照进客厅，佛尔思瘫在沙发里，发出意义不明的哀叹，手边的笔记本上只胡乱画了只卷毛狒狒。

      “我本以为《大冒险家》第二卷的进度很理想。”奥黛丽端着茶杯，眼眸含笑，“看来还是遇到了一些困难，比如……如何处理真实与虚构的占比？”
      佛尔思沮丧地合上笔记本：“那位编辑先生一定不知道，他在要求我杜撰谁的虚假罗曼史。”
      奥黛丽露出了更加愉快的笑容：“而他更不知道，沃尔女士为之痛苦的，并非不想写，而是——她也很想写。”

      甜香交织的会客室中，女孩们的笑声像饼干上的砂糖一般突然滚落。桌边安静趴着的金毛大狗扫了扫尾巴，眼睛微微睁开，很快又舒服地眯了起来。
      ——这片刻闲暇，便是她们赖以穿梭于末日阴影之下，最温柔也最坚实的“锚点”。
ref_en:
Sunlight slanted into the living room. Fors lay sprawled on the sofa, letting out an inexplicable sigh, with only a crudely drawn curly-haired baboon on the notebook beside her hand.

      "I thought the progress of the second volume of 'The Great Adventurer' was quite ideal." Audrey held her teacup, her eyes smiling, "It seems you've encountered some difficulties, such as... how to handle the ratio of reality to fiction?"
      Fors closed her notebook in frustration: "That editor gentleman must not know whose fake romance he is asking me to fabricate."
      Audrey revealed an even more pleasant smile: "And he knows even less that what Ms. Wall is agonizing over is not that she doesn't want to write, but—she also very much wants to write."

      In the parlor intertwined with sweet fragrance, the girls' laughter rolled out suddenly like the sugar on a biscuit. The golden retriever lying quietly by the table flicked its tail, its eyes opening slightly, before quickly squinting comfortably again.
      —This brief leisure was the gentlest and most solid "anchor" they relied on to traverse beneath the shadows of the apocalypse.

ref_en:
<Highlight> Beyonder Aggregation </>: You can aggregate two Beyonder materials into a new Beyonder material. 
 <Highlight> Affix Inheritance </>: During Beyonder aggregation, the affixes of the resulting product will be <Highlight> all </> randomly selected from the affixes of the <Highlight> Beyonder materials </> put in. 
 <Highlight> Affix Mutation </>: When the total number of affixes of the Beyonder materials put into the aggregation is 6 or more, there is a very small probability of mutation occurring after aggregation, generating a mutated affix. If the total quantity and types of affixes of the Beyonder materials put into the aggregation are different, the mutated affixes that can appear will be different. Each time you aggregate, if no mutation occurs, the probability of triggering a mutation in subsequent aggregations will increase. 
 <Highlight> Affix Upgrade </>: When the total number of affixes of the Beyonder materials put into the aggregation is 6 or more, there is a probability of triggering an affix upgrade after aggregation, increasing the attribute values of some affixes. 
 <Highlight> Advanced Aggregation </>: When you currently possess 2 Attack Beyonder materials with 4 or more affixes and 2 Defense Beyonder materials with 4 or more affixes, you unlock the ability to put 4-affix Attack Beyonder materials into aggregation; when you currently possess 2 Attack Beyonder materials with 5 affixes and 2 Defense Beyonder materials with 5 affixes, you unlock the ability to put 5-affix Beyonder materials into aggregation. 
 <Highlight> Aggregation Proficiency </>: Performing Beyonder material aggregation will increase <Highlight> Aggregation Proficiency </>. Aggregation Proficiency resets each season, and you can receive rewards after reaching a certain value.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【诡变宝箱】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>没有哪位经验丰富的探索者，会轻易相信一份毫无来由的财富。它们有的早已失去主人，有的仍处于守护之下，也有一些只是岁月的痕迹。对于非凡者而言，每一次尝试，都意味着一次选择，这一切的谜题，都等着你来揭晓。用武力和欺骗的手段战胜他们，让他们看看谁才是猎物。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找诡变宝箱</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【诡变宝箱】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【诡变宝箱】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 与宝箱互动</>
到达目标地点后，与奇怪的宝箱互动，选择开启宝箱，会惊动宝箱周围的敌人。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 应对选择</>
被敌人发现后，可选择不同方式应对：
<Assistant_Red>正面迎战：</>击败敌人即可获得宝箱奖励。
<Assistant_Red>天赋检定：</>通过对应检定，同样可以获得宝箱奖励；若检定失败，则需进入战斗完成挑战。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Mysterious Treasure Chest】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>No experienced explorer would easily trust wealth that appears out of nowhere. Some have long lost their owners, some remain under guard, and others are merely traces of time. For a Beyonder, every attempt represents a choice, and all these puzzles are waiting for you to solve them. Use force and deception to defeat them and show them who the real prey is.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding a Mysterious Treasure Chest</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Mysterious Treasure Chest] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Mysterious Treasure Chest] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Interacting with the Chest</>
After arriving at the target location, interact with the strange treasure chest and choose to open it, which will alert the enemies surrounding it.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Responding to Choices</>
Once discovered by enemies, you can choose different ways to respond:
<Assistant_Red>Head-on Battle:</>Defeat the enemies to obtain the treasure chest reward.
<Assistant_Red>Talent Check:</>Pass the corresponding check to also obtain the treasure chest reward; if the check fails, you must enter combat to complete the challenge.

source_cn:
白银城的前任首席曾是最强大的半神之一。
为了守护这座永夜中的城市，为了寻找通往光明的道路，他选择了转换途径，在陵寝中闭关，试图晋升。
那是一条未被验证的道路，没人知道结果。但有人必须尝试。
他失败了。
当科林·伊利亚特率队打开陵寝时，看见的是一具头骨和一堆散落的非凡特性——它们融合在一起，化为了这张面具。
“首席……”队员们低下头。
科林沉默地走上前，将面具封存。回到白银城后，他在议事会上说：
“前任首席证明了这条路走不通。他用自己的失败，为我们排除了一个错误的方向。”
有人不解：“那这张面具……”
科林看向封印容器中的黄昏面具。空洞的眼眶，苍白的头骨，那是探索者留下的最后遗物。
“它提醒着我们，在黑暗中寻找光明，每一次尝试都有代价。但正是这些失败，让我们知道哪些路不该走，哪些路还有希望。”
科林将面具郑重地封存在圆塔之内处。
“他没有白白牺牲。他为白银城的未来，探明了一条死路，让后来者可以选择其他方向。”
圆塔的门缓缓关上。此路不通，但探索不止。
ref_en:
The former Chief of the City of Silver was once one of the most powerful Demigods. 
 To protect this city in eternal night and to find the path to the light, he chose to switch pathways and went into seclusion in the mausoleum, attempting an advancement. 
 It was an unverified path; no one knew the outcome. But someone had to try. 
 He failed. 
 When Colin Iliad led a team to open the mausoleum, what they saw was a skull and a pile of scattered Beyonder characteristics—they had fused together, turning into this mask. 
 "Chief..." the team members lowered their heads. 
 Colin walked forward in silence and sealed the mask. After returning to the City of Silver, he said at the council meeting: 
 "The former Chief proved that this path is impassable. With his failure, he eliminated an incorrect direction for us." 
 Someone was puzzled: "Then this mask..." 
 Colin looked at the Twilight Mask in the sealed container. The hollow eye sockets and the pale skull were the last relics left by the explorer. 
 "It reminds us that searching for light in the darkness has a price for every attempt. But it is precisely these failures that let us know which paths should not be taken and which paths still hold hope." 
 Colin solemnly sealed the mask inside the Round Tower. 
 "He did not sacrifice himself in vain. He explored a dead end for the future of the City of Silver, allowing those who come after to choose other directions." 
 The door of the Round Tower slowly closed. This path is impassable, but the exploration continues.
Keep an eye on those people!

<Assistant_Title2>搭配阶段：</>本场主题公布后，满足资格的俱乐部成员可以进入搭配界面，根据主题关卡进行时装搭配。保存搭配后会计算搭配评分，并进入俱乐部本场评分排名。动作搭配主要影响表演效果，不影响评分。
<Assistant_Title2>风格：</>每件外观拥有5组对立风格中的属性，如优雅/嬉皮、光明/黑暗、简约/奢华、纯真/冷酷、春夏/秋冬。每场会指定主风格和次风格，主风格权重更高。
<Assistant_Title2>分数来源：</>单件服饰风格分会根据和每场主题的匹配度计算出基本分数，还会根据不同的染色等级受到染色加成；最终总分还会受到风尚鉴赏收集度的全局加成影响。
<Assistant_Title2>参赛选手：</>进入调整阶段后，搭配会被锁定，俱乐部本场搭配评分前<Assistant_Red>5</>的成员自动成为参赛选手。
<Assistant_Title2>调整顺序：</>有权限的管理者可以调整5名参赛选手的出场顺序；比赛前一段时间会禁止继续调整。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Phantom of the Opera - Coordination Rules】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Coordination Phase: </>After the theme for the round is announced, eligible club members can enter the coordination interface to perform fashion coordination based on the theme level. After saving the coordination, the coordination score will be calculated, and you will enter the club's score ranking for this round. Action coordination mainly affects performance effects and does not affect the score. 
<Assistant_Title2>Style: </>Each appearance has attributes from 5 opposing style groups, such as Elegant/Hippie, Light/Dark, Minimalist/Luxurious, Innocent/Cold, Spring-Summer/Autumn-Winter. Each round will specify a main style and a secondary style, with the main style having a higher weight. 
<Assistant_Title2>Score Source: </>The style score of a single piece of clothing will be calculated based on the matching degree with each round's theme, and will also receive dyeing bonuses based on different dyeing levels; the final total score will also be affected by the global bonus of Fashion Appreciation collection. 
<Assistant_Title2>Contestants: </>After entering the adjustment phase, the coordination will be locked, and the top <Assistant_Red>5</> members in the club's coordination score for this round will automatically become contestants. 
<Assistant_Title2>Adjusting Order: </>Authorized managers can adjust the appearance order of the 5 contestants; adjusting will be prohibited for a period of time before the match.

当你展开这封信笺时，芬芳的气息已将你包裹。这并非偶然，而是必然的命运——你被选中了。

　　在贝克兰德雾气弥漫的街头，在廷根宁静的小巷深处，有这样一群人：他们追求极致的美丽，拥抱命运的无常，在灾厄中翩翩起舞。

　　我们是春夜舞会。

　　我们侍奉的是不幸与美丽的源头，是将灾难化作艺术的存在。在祂的庇护下，我们明晰了一个真理：

　　真正的美，诞生于毁灭与重生之间。

　　若你愿意加入我们，请前往"珠宝店"门口右侧。

　　记住，我们不接受怯懦者，不欢迎虚伪者。唯有敢于凝视深渊，敢于拥抱真实的人，才配得上这场永不落幕的舞会。

　　期待你的到来。
ref_en:
When you unfold this letter, a fragrant scent has already enveloped you. This is not a coincidence, but an inevitable fate—you have been chosen.

	In the fog-filled streets of Backlund, in the depths of the quiet alleys of Tingen, there is a group of people: they pursue ultimate beauty, embrace the impermanence of fate, and dance gracefully amidst disaster.

	We are the Spring Night Ball.

	We serve the source of misfortune and beauty, an existence that turns disaster into art. Under His shelter, we have realized a truth:

	True beauty is born between destruction and rebirth.

	If you are willing to join us, please go to the right side of the entrance of the "Jewelry Store".

	Remember, we do not accept the cowardly, nor do we welcome the hypocritical. Only those who dare to gaze into the abyss and dare to embrace the truth are worthy of this never-ending Curtain Call.

	We look forward to your arrival.

source_cn: 廷根下街传来虚弱呼喊，女孩珍妮向路人寻求一根火柴，但人们却对她视而不见。你买来火柴后，珍妮欣喜不已。划亮火柴后，你在火光中看见珍妮的渴望之物：舒适的衣物、丰盛的菜肴和死去的妈妈。回到现实，路人称你一直自言自语，透露珍妮早已饿死街头。原来珍妮是亡魂，那火光中的一切不过是幻象。
ref_en: A weak cry comes from Lower Street in Tingen; a girl named Jenny asks passersby for a match, but people turn a blind eye to her. After you buy her a match, Jenny is overjoyed. After lighting the match, you see in the firelight what Jenny longs for: comfortable clothes, a sumptuous meal, and her deceased mother. Back in reality, passersby say you have been talking to yourself, revealing that Jenny died of starvation on the street long ago. It turns out Jenny is a ghost, and everything in the firelight was just an illusion.

<Assistant_Title2>System Entry: </><Assistant_System>Voice Room - Permission Settings in the bottom left corner</>{JumpToUI:[【Go to View】]|1250316}
<Assistant_Title2>Free Speaking Mode: </>All players can unmute and speak.
<Assistant_Title2>Host Sets Speaking Permissions: </>In this mode, players can click the microphone button to actively request to speak, and can gain speaking permissions after the host approves. The host can also manually adjust player speaking permissions in the player list.
<Assistant_Title2>Host Sets Speaking Order: </>In this mode, up to 8 speaking order seats can be set. It defaults to sequential speaking; only the host and the player in seat #1 can unmute. After the player in seat #1 finishes speaking, they must click to step down to pass the speaking order to the player in seat #2.
<Assistant_Title2>Mute: </>Muted players will not be able to perform real-time voice, send voice messages, or send text messages in this voice room. The host can set this in the Mute Management tab.
<Assistant_Title2>Blacklist: </>Blacklisted players will be kicked out of this voice room and will not be able to enter again. The host can set this in the Blacklist tab.
